description: Fork of exp291 (no-wd-on-LUTs dual-stream, b=8 -> 1.6749). Three coupled changes: (1) REMOVE v_lut entirely; V is just raw x_lut broadcast across H heads (V shape (B, H, T, E=64)). (2) d_v = E = 64 (set so out_proj input = H*d_v = 384 matches the broadcast V). (3) out_proj becomes much bigger: flat NAP=6 tph=8192 across all 6 layers (was per-layer [2048,2048,1024,1024,1024,1024]). Param impact: -v_lut (~75.5M) + bigger out_proj (~+168M) = ~+92M. Total ~443M.
